instruction: Open the Script-Fu console and use it to flatten this image, then export the flattened result to the Desktop as fu.png.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: 'Desktop/fu.png', format: 'file_magic', offset: 0, length: 8, default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
